title: Mean and Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $U$ be a set of coordinates. The mean of the pointwise product of $f$ with the monomial that multiplies the signs in $U$ equals the Fourier coefficient of $f$ indexed by $U$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
